start: Member with Plus access (free month, gym member or paid); exercise page of Bench Press with recent sets

steps.action: Tap '1-rep max and % calculator' on the exercise chart
user_sees: Screen '1-rep max' with subtitle 'Bench Press'; boxes 'Weight (kg)' and 'Reps' filled; 'Filled in from your best recent set.'
must_not: Boxes filled from a warm-up set; another exercise's name

user_sees: 'Your estimated 1-rep max' in large figures, the same as the chart's 'Estimated 1-rep max'
must_not: A different estimate from the chart for the same set

user_sees: Rows from 95 % down to 50 % with 'Weight' and 'Plates per side' using the member's bar and plates
must_not: A weight the bar and plates cannot make; plates per side for a load under the bar

steps.action: Open the 1-rep max calculator from the plate calculator
user_sees: Weight box starts at 100, Reps empty; 'Type a weight and reps to see your 1-rep max.'
The estimate and the percentage table
must_not: No subtitle crash when no exercise is given

user_sees: 'Weight must be more than 0.' and no table
'Reps must be a whole number from 1 to 100.'
'Type a weight and reps to see your 1-rep max.'

start: Free member without Plus (free month over, not in a gym) opens a link straight to the calculator

must_not: The calculator usable for free; a blank screen

user_sees: The page before, not the calculator again

start: Calculator opened from an exercise; member changes the boxes

user_sees: 'Filled in from your best recent set.' disappears; result updates as typed
must_not: The prefill overwriting what was typed when recent sets load late

steps.action: Plus access ends while the screen is open (free month ends today)
user_sees: The screen stays until it is left; next open goes to Plus
must_not: Calculator kept open for free on every later open
